name: apaper-plugin
description: Academic paper research, writing, and publication-quality figures in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Research, write, and illustrate academic papers
interface.longDescription: Search the literature with apaper-mcp, revise academic prose and theorem statements, and create publication-quality TikZ or CeTZ figures. The MCP server requires uvx and Python 3.12+; figure compilation requires LaTeX or Typst.
defaultPrompt: Find related papers for my research topic.
Revise my abstract for clarity and precision.
Create a publication-quality diagram for my paper.
